title: Solutions Overview
meta_description: 24 outcome-based solutions: a named business problem, a composed architecture, a platform stack and a metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: A no-theater description of Solutions Overview: what ships first, what it touches at operational stores, how it is verified, and the per workflow metric we commit to moving against baseline.

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Solutions Overview
blocks.note: The decision layer is shared infrastructure: one contract per consumer, one ledger per decision, one owner per metric.

blocks.x: We engineer Solutions Overview so that regressions are cohorts, not surprises: each stage owns its latency budget and failure policy, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.
The short version of Solutions Overview: named metrics, named owners, evidence that travels. The sections below walk through the pattern, the components and the commitments.

blocks.caption: Solutions at a glance
rows: conversion lift — clean-room verified per campaign
conversion rate — up 10-25% on rebuilt paths

time-to-recovery — proven against RTO in drills
disruption impact — down 30-50% on instrumented events
STP on target processes — up 25-45 points
knowledge-task time — down 30-50% on instrumented roles
